div.head: Northu 2.1
div.ab: ⁊ gif hit ænig preost elles gedó, þolige his wurðscipes ⁊ geferena freondscipes ⁊ he nahwar ne mæssige, ær hig hæbbe se þe hi mid rihte age.
And gif hit ænig preost elles gedo, þolige his wurðscipes and geferena freondscipes, and he nahwar ne mæssige ær hig hæbbe se þe hi mid rihte age.

Und wenn ausser diesem Falle irgend ein Priester das thut, verliere er seinen Ehrenrang und die Angehörigkeit der Genossen und er lese nirgends Messe, bevor der [Pfarrer], dem die [Kirche] gesetzmässig gehört, sie [zurück] erhält.

And if, other than in this case, any priest does it, let him lose his rank of honour and the fellowship of his companions, and let him say mass nowhere before the [priest] to whom the [church] lawfully belongs has it [back].

And if any priest does so in any other circumstance, he is to forfeit his dignity and the friendship of his colleagues, and he is not to celebrate mass anywhere until he who rightly owns the church is in possession of it.

Yet if any priest does so for any other reason, he is to forfeit his status and the fellowship of his colleagues, and he is not to hold Mass anywhere until he who properly possesses that church recovers it.
div.note: U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘And if any priest does so in any other circumstsance, he is to forfeit his dignity and the friendship of his colleagues, and he is not to celebrate mass anywhere until he who rightly owns the church is in possession of it.’).
